High quality giantess game with interactive 3D sequences, designed for VR.
Interact with various characters from the Grim Glitter series to experience a variety of giantess scenarios.

(Mechanics are simplified for VR purposes)
Explore a handful of different town and room levels with giant girls, who will passively move around and interact with the environment. Interact with the girls during various states to initiate a variety of animated events, or start them directly from the menu.
